verses.geez: ከመ፡ ውሒዘ፡ ማይ፡ ከማሁ፡ ልበ፡ ንጉሥ፡ ውስተ፡ እደ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ኀበ፡ ፈቀደ፡ ይመይጣ፡ ወህየ፡ ትመሲ።
verses.translation: As a rush of water, so is the king's heart in God's hand: he turns it whithersoever he may desire to point out.

translations.lxx: As a rush of water, so is the king's heart in God's hand: he turns it whithersoever he may desire to point out.
translations.kjv: The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.
translations.ron: Asemenea unui curs de apă este inima regelui în mâna Domnului, pe care îl îndreaptă încotro vrea.

verses.geez: ኵሉ፡ ብእሲ፡ ያስተርኢ፡ ለርእሱ፡ ጻድቀ፡ ወያረትዕ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አልባበ።
verses.translation: Every man seems to himself righteous; but the Lord directs the hearts.

translations.lxx: Every man seems to himself righteous; but the Lord directs the hearts.
translations.kjv: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes: but the LORD pondereth the hearts.
translations.ron: Toată calea omului este dreaptă în ochii lui, dar numai Domnul cântăreşte inimile.

verses.geez: ገቢረ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ህልው፡ ወሥሙር፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ፈድፋደ፡ እምዘቢሐ፡ መሥዋዕት።
verses.translation: To do justly and to speak truth, are more pleasing to God than the blood of sacrifices.

translations.lxx: To do justly and to speak truth, are more pleasing to God than the blood of sacrifices.
translations.kjv: To do justice and judgment is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.
translations.ron: Făptuirea dreptăţii şi a judecăţii este mai de preţ pentru Domnul decât jertfa sângeroasă.

verses.geez: ዓቢይ፡ ሕሊና፡ ኢጐጒዖ፡ ልብ፡ ለጽእለት፡ ወብርሃኖሙ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ ኃጢአት።
verses.translation: A high-minded man is stout-hearted in his pride; and the lamp of the wicked is sin.

translations.lxx: A high-minded man is stout-hearted in his pride; and the lamp of the wicked is sin.
translations.kjv: An high look, and a proud heart, and the plowing of the wicked, is sin.
translations.ron: Ochii semeţi şi inima îngâmfată sunt sfeşnicul păcătoşilor. Aceasta nu este decât păcat.

verses.geez: ዘይትቀነይ፡ መዝገበ፡ ልሳነ፡ ሐሰት፡ ከንቶ፡ ይዴግን፡ ወያበጽሖ፡ ውስተ፡ መሥገርተ፡ ሞት።

translations.kjv: The thoughts of the diligent tend only to plenteousness; but of every one that is hasty only to want.
translations.ron: Chibzuiala omului silitor duce numai la câştig, iar cel ce se zoreşte ajunge la pagubă.

verses.geez: ሥራዌ፡ ረሲዓን፡ ይትነገድ፡ እምርኁቅ፡ እስመ፡ ኢይፈቅዱ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ጽድቀ።
verses.translation: He that gathers treasures with a lying tongue pursues vanity on to the snares of death.

translations.lxx: He that gathers treasures with a lying tongue pursues vanity on to the snares of death.
translations.kjv: The getting of treasures by a lying tongue is a vanity tossed to and fro of them that seek death.
translations.ron: Comorile dobândite cu limbă mincinoasă sunt deşertăciune trecătoare şi laţuri ale morţii.

verses.geez: ለዕልዋን፡ ዕልወ፡ ፍኖተ፡ ይፌኑ፡ ሎሙ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እስመ፡ ርቱዕ፡ ወንጹሕ፡ ምግባሩ።
verses.translation: Destruction shall lodge with the ungodly; for they refuse to do justly.

translations.lxx: Destruction shall lodge with the ungodly; for they refuse to do justly.
translations.kjv: The robbery of the wicked shall destroy them; because they refuse to do judgment.
translations.ron: Silnicia celor fără de lege se ţine după ei, căci nu voiesc să înfăptuiască dreptatea.

verses.geez: ይኄይስ፡ ነቢር፡ ውስተ፡ ማዕዘንት፡ ዘኢኮነ፡ ጥፉረ፡ እምነ፡ ቢር፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲት፡ መግዝእት፡ ውስተ፡ ቤት፡ ምሩግ።
verses.translation: To the froward God sends froward ways; for his works are pure and right.

translations.lxx: To the froward God sends froward ways; for his works are pure and right.
translations.kjv: The way of man is froward and strange: but as for the pure, his work is right.
translations.ron: Calea celui răufăcător e sucită; cel nevinovat lucrează drept.

verses.geez: ነፍሰ፡ ረሲዓን፡ ኢትትመሐር፡ ወኢ፡ በኀበ፡ አሐዱሂ፡ ሰብእ።
verses.translation: It is better to dwell in a corner on the house-top, than in plastered rooms with unrighteousness, and in an open house.

translations.lxx: It is better to dwell in a corner on the house-top, than in plastered rooms with unrighteousness, and in an open house.
translations.kjv: It is better to dwell in a corner of the housetop, than with a brawling woman in a wide house.
translations.ron: Mai degrabă să locuieşti într-un colţ pe acoperiş, decât cu o femeie certăreaţă şi într-o casă mare.

verses.geez: እንዘ፡ የኃሥር፡ ጸዋግ፡ ማእምረ፡ ይከውን፡ የዋህ፡ ወዘይጤቅስ፡ ጥበበ፡ ይትዌከፍ፡ አእምሮ።
verses.translation: The soul of the ungodly shall not be pitied by any man.

translations.lxx: The soul of the ungodly shall not be pitied by any man.
translations.kjv: The soul of the wicked desireth evil: his neighbour findeth no favour in his eyes.
translations.ron: Sufletul celui fără de lege pofteşte răutatea, iar aproapele lui nu află milă în ochii lui.

verses.geez: ኢየአምር፡ ጥበበ፡ ልበ፡ ረሲዓን፡ ወየአክዮሙ፡ ለረሲዓን፡ እከይ።
verses.translation: When an intemperate man is punished the simple becomes wiser: and a wise man understanding will receive knowledge.

translations.lxx: When an intemperate man is punished the simple becomes wiser: and a wise man understanding will receive knowledge.
translations.kjv: When the scorner is punished, the simple is made wise: and when the wise is instructed, he receiveth knowledge.
translations.ron: Când cel batjocoritor e pedepsit, cel fără minte se înţelepţeşte şi când cel înţelept este dojenit, el câştigă în ştiinţă.

verses.geez: ዘይፌፅም፡ ዕዘኒሁ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይስማዕ፡ ነዳያነ፡ ውእቱኒ፡ ይጼውእ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ዘይሰምዖ።
verses.translation: A righteous man understands the hearts of the ungodly: and despises the ungodly for their wickedness.

translations.lxx: A righteous man understands the hearts of the ungodly: and despises the ungodly for their wickedness.
translations.kjv: The righteous man wisely considereth the house of the wicked: but God overthroweth the wicked for their wickedness.
translations.ron: Dreptul ia aminte la casa celui nelegiuit. Dumnezeu prăbuşeşte pe cei fără de lege în nenorocire.

verses.geez: ሀብት፡ ዘበጽሚት፡ ይገፍዕ፡ መዓተ፡ ወዘሰ፡ ይምህክ፡ ሀብተ፡ ያነሥእ፡ ጽኑዐ፡ መዓተ።
verses.translation: He that stops his ears from hearing the poor, himself also shall cry, and there shall be none to hear him.

translations.lxx: He that stops his ears from hearing the poor, himself also shall cry, and there shall be none to hear him.
translations.kjv: Whoso stoppeth his ears at the cry of the poor, he also shall cry himself, but shall not be heard.
translations.ron: Cine îşi astupă urechea la strigătul celui sărman şi el, când va striga, nu i se va răspunde.

verses.geez: ፍሥሐ፡ ጻድቃን፡ ገቢረ፡ ፍትሕ፡ ወጻድቅ፡ ባሕቱ፡ ርኩስ፡ በኀበ፡ እኩያነ፡ ምግባር።
verses.translation: A secret gift calms anger: but he that forbears to give stirs up strong wrath.

translations.lxx: A secret gift calms anger: but he that forbears to give stirs up strong wrath.
translations.kjv: A gift in secret pacifieth anger: and a reward in the bosom strong wrath.
translations.ron: Un dar făcut într-ascuns potoleşte mânia şi un plocon scos din sân, o mânie puternică.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ ዘይስሕት፡ እምፍኖተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ውስተ፡ ማሕበረ፡ ረሲዓን፡ የዓርፍ።
verses.translation: It is the joy of the righteous to do judgment: but a holy man is abominable with evil-doers.

translations.lxx: It is the joy of the righteous to do judgment: but a holy man is abominable with evil-doers.
translations.kjv: It is joy to the just to do judgment: but destruction shall be to the workers of iniquity.
translations.ron: Dreptul tresaltă de bucurie când poate să pună în faptă dreptatea, iar spaima e pentru cei ce săvârşesc fărădelegea.

verses.geez: ብእሲ፡ ጽኑዕ፡ ያፈቅር፡ ፍሥሐ፡ ወዘያፈቅር፡ ወይነ፡ ወቅብዐ፡ ኢይብዕል።
verses.translation: A man that wanders out of the way of righteousness, shall rest in the congregation of giants.

translations.lxx: A man that wanders out of the way of righteousness, shall rest in the congregation of giants.
translations.kjv: The man that wandereth out of the way of understanding shall remain in the congregation of the dead.
translations.ron: Un om care rătăceşte de pe drumul înţelepciunii, se va odihni curând în adunarea celor morţi.

verses.geez: ምኑን፡ ኃጥእ፡ በኀበ፡ ጻድቅ፡ ወቤዛሁ፡ ለጻድቅ፡ ይትወሀብ፡ ረሲዕ።
verses.translation: A poor man loves mirth, loving wine and oil in abundance;

translations.lxx: A poor man loves mirth, loving wine and oil in abundance;
translations.kjv: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.
translations.ron: Cel ce iubeşte veselia va duce lipsă; cel căruia îi place vinul şi miresmele nu se îmbogăţeşte.

verses.geez: ይኄይስ፡ ነቢር፡ ውስተ፡ ገዳም፡ እምነቢር፡ ምስለ፡ ብእሲት፡ መግዝእት፡ ወነባቢት፡ ወመዓትምት።
verses.translation: and a transgressor is the abomination of a righteous man.

translations.lxx: and a transgressor is the abomination of a righteous man.
translations.kjv: The wicked shall be a ransom for the righteous, and the transgressor for the upright.
translations.ron: Nelegiuitul slujeşte ca preţ de răscumpărare pentru cel drept şi vicleanul pentru cel fără prihană.

verses.geez: መዝገብ፡ መፍትው፡ ውስተ፡ አፈ፡ ጠቢባን፡ ዐብዳንሰ፡ ሰብእ፡ የኃጥእዎ።
verses.translation: It is better to dwell in a wilderness than with a quarrelsome and talkative and passionate woman.

translations.lxx: It is better to dwell in a wilderness than with a quarrelsome and talkative and passionate woman.
translations.kjv: It is better to dwell in the wilderness, than with a contentious and an angry woman.
translations.ron: Mai bine să locuieşti în pustiu decât cu o femeie certăreaţă şi supărăcioasă.

verses.geez: ዘይዴግን፡ ፍኖተ፡ ጽድቅ፡ ወሕይወት፡ ይረክብ፡ ክብረ፡ ወሕይወተ።
verses.translation: A desirable treasure will rest on the mouth of the wise; but foolish men will swallow it up.

translations.lxx: A desirable treasure will rest on the mouth of the wise; but foolish men will swallow it up.
translations.kjv: There is treasure to be desired and oil in the dwelling of the wise; but a foolish man spendeth it up.
translations.ron: Comori de preţ şi untdelemn (se găsesc) în casa celui înţelept, dar omul cel nebun le risipeşte.

verses.geez: ለሀገር፡ ጽንዕት፡ ቦአ፡ ጠቢብ፡ ወነሠተ፡ ጽንዐ፡ በዘይትዌከሉ፡ ረሲዓን።
verses.translation: The way of righteousness and mercy will find life and glory.

translations.lxx: The way of righteousness and mercy will find life and glory.
translations.kjv: He that followeth after righteousness and mercy findeth life, righteousness, and honour.
translations.ron: Cel ce umblă în calea dreptăţii şi a milei află viaţă, dreptate şi mărire.

verses.geez: ዘየዐቅብ፡ አፉሁ፡ ወልሳኖ፡ ይትመኀፀና፡ ለነፍሱ፡ እምንዳቤ።
verses.translation: A wise man assaults strong cities, and demolishes the fortress in which the ungodly trusted.

translations.lxx: A wise man assaults strong cities, and demolishes the fortress in which the ungodly trusted.
translations.kjv: A wise man scaleth the city of the mighty, and casteth down the strength of the confidence thereof.
translations.ron: Înţeleptul ia cu luptă cruntă cetatea vitejilor şi răstoarnă întăriturile în care ei îşi puneau nădejdea.

verses.geez: ጒጒዕ፡ ወመግዝእ፡ ወነባቢ፡ ብድብድ፡ ስሙ፡ ወዘይዜክርሰ፡ እከየ፡ ኃጥእ፡ ውእቱ።
verses.translation: He that keeps his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from trouble.

translations.lxx: He that keeps his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from trouble.
translations.kjv: Whoso keepeth his mouth and his tongue keepeth his soul from troubles.
translations.ron: Cel ce-şi păzeşte gura şi limba lui îşi păzeşte sufletul lui de primejdie.

verses.geez: ፍትወት፡ ይቀትላሁ፡ ለሀካይ፡ እስመ፡ ኢይፈቅድ፡ እደዊሁ፡ ይግበራ፡ ምንተኒ።
verses.translation: A bold and self-willed and insolent man is called a pest: and he that remembers injuries is a transgressor.

translations.lxx: A bold and self-willed and insolent man is called a pest: and he that remembers injuries is a transgressor.
translations.kjv: Proud and haughty scorner is his name, who dealeth in proud wrath.
translations.ron: Cine este semeţ şi îngâmfat se cheamă batjocoritor; acela se poartă cu prisos de trufie.

verses.geez: ረሲዕ፡ ይፈቅድ፡ ወይፈቱ፡ ኵላ፡ ዕለተ፡ ፍትወተ፡ እኪተ፡ ጻድቅሰ፡ ይምሕር፡ ወይመጸውት፡ ኵሎ፡ አእሚሮ።
verses.translation: Desires kill the sluggard; for his hands do not choose to do anything.

translations.lxx: Desires kill the sluggard; for his hands do not choose to do anything.
translations.kjv: The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
translations.ron: Pofta celui leneş îl omoară, căci mâinile nu voiesc să lucreze.

verses.geez: መሥዋዕተ፡ ረሲዓን፡ ምኑን፡ በኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ እስመ፡ በእከይ፡ ያቀርብዎ።
verses.translation: An ungodly man entertains evil desires all the day: but the righteous is unsparingly merciful and compassionate.

translations.lxx: An ungodly man entertains evil desires all the day: but the righteous is unsparingly merciful and compassionate.
translations.kjv: He coveteth greedily all the day long: but the righteous giveth and spareth not.
translations.ron: Mereu cel fără de lege pofteşte, iar cel drept dă şi nu se zgârceşte.

verses.geez: ሰማዕተ፡ ሐሰት፡ ይትኃጐል፡ ወብእሲሰ፡ ሰማዒ፡ ዕቁበ፡ ይትናገር።
verses.translation: The sacrifices of the ungodly are abomination to the Lord, for they offer them wickedly.

translations.lxx: The sacrifices of the ungodly are abomination to the Lord, for they offer them wickedly.
translations.kjv: The sacrifice of the wicked is abomination: how much more, when he bringeth it with a wicked mind?
translations.ron: Jertfa celor nelegiuiţi este urâciune pentru Domnul, mai cu seamă când o aduc pentru o faptă ruşinoasă.

verses.geez: ረሲዕ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘእንበለ፡ ኃፍረት፡ ይትቃወም፡ ለገጽ፡ ወራትዕሰ፡ ይጤይቅ፡ ፍኖቶ።
verses.translation: A false witness shall perish; but an obedient man will speak cautiously.

translations.lxx: A false witness shall perish; but an obedient man will speak cautiously.
translations.kjv: A false witness shall perish: but the man that heareth speaketh constantly.
translations.ron: Martorul mincinos va pieri, iar omul care ascultă va putea vorbi totdeauna.

verses.geez: አልቦ፡ ጥበብ፡ ወአልቦ፡ እዘዝ፡ በኀበ፡ ዐብድ፡ ወአልቦ፡ ምክር፡ በኀበ፡ ረሲዕ።
verses.translation: An ungodly man impudently withstands with his face; but the upright man himself understands his ways.

translations.lxx: An ungodly man impudently withstands with his face; but the upright man himself understands his ways.
translations.kjv: A wicked man hardeneth his face: but as for the upright, he directeth his way.
translations.ron: Răufăcătorul are o privire neruşinată, iar omul cel drept îşi ia aminte la purtarea lui.

verses.geez: ፈረሰ፡ ያስተዳልዉ፡ ለዕለተ፡ ጸብእ፡ ረድኤትሰ፡ እምኀበ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ ይከውን።
verses.translation: There is no wisdom, there is no courage, there is no counsel against the ungodly.

translations.lxx: There is no wisdom, there is no courage, there is no counsel against the ungodly.
translations.kjv: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.
translations.ron: Nu este nici înţelepciune, nici pricepere şi nici sfat care să aibă putere înaintea Domnului.
